messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** strike the best balance.

| What you want | Why it works |
|---------------|--------------|
| **Great weather** | Temperatures stay warm (70–80 °F / 21–27 °C) but not scorching, and humidity is lower than in summer. |
| **Fewer crowds** | These months sit just outside the peak tourist seasons (December‑January for Christmas/New Year and July‑August for school holidays). |
| **Better deals** | Hotels, flights, and tours often offer lower rates than during the high‑season months. |
| **Wildlife & nature** | Whale watching peaks in January‑March, but the water is still clear and calm in late spring/early fall. |

### Quick rundown of the seasons

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds | Price |
|--------|-----------------|--------|-------|
| **Winter (Dec‑Feb)** | 68–75 °F (20–24 °C) | High (holiday travel) | High |
| **Spring (Mar‑Jun)** | 70–80 °F (21–27 °C) | Low‑mid | Mid‑low |
| **Summer (Jul‑Aug)** | 78–85 °F (26–29 °C) | High | High |
| **Fall (Sep‑Nov)** | 70–80 °F (21–27 °C) | Low‑mid | Mid‑low |

### Bottom line

If you’re after a mix of pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for **April, May, September, or October**. If you’re okay with higher prices and don’t mind larger crowds, the summer months (especially July and August) are great for beach parties and festivals. And if you’re a whale‑watching enthusiast, plan for January‑March.
